universal.zh: 把變速箱的輸出轉到後差速器。後驅車的傳動軸很長，所以做成兩截，中間用中心軸承掛在車底，前端用橡膠撓性盤接變速箱。
universal.en: Carries the gearbox output to the rear differential. On a rear-drive car it is long, so it is made in two pieces with a centre bearing hung from the floor and a rubber flex disc at the gearbox end.

specific.zh: BMW 的撓性盤俗稱 Giubo。拆時先拆中段排氣與隔熱板，鬆中心軸承，前後法蘭各幾顆螺絲。
specific.en: BMW's flex disc is nicknamed the Giubo. Remove the mid exhaust and heat shield, drop the centre bearing, then the flange bolts at each end.

fasteners.desc: 撓性盤螺絲 / Flex disc bolts
差速器法蘭螺絲 / Diff flange bolts

warnings.zh: 做記號保持前後兩截的相位，裝錯會抖。
warnings.en: Mark the two halves so they go back in the same phase, or it vibrates.

commonIssues.zh: 撓性盤龜裂、中心軸承橡膠塌陷：起步「咚」一聲或高速抖動。
commonIssues.en: Cracked flex disc or collapsed centre bearing rubber: a clunk on take-off or a high-speed shudder.

universal.zh: 六顆螺絲穿過一塊橡膠盤，三顆接變速箱、三顆接傳動軸，吸收扭力衝擊與小角度偏差。
universal.en: Six bolts through a rubber disc, three to the gearbox and three to the shaft, absorb torque shocks and small misalignment.

specific.zh: 有方向性，箭頭要對正確法蘭（待查證）。
specific.en: It is directional; the arrows must point to the correct flange (unverified).

universal.zh: 兩截傳動軸中間的軸承，外面包橡膠掛在車底，讓軸可以微微擺動。
universal.en: The bearing between the two shaft halves, in a rubber mount hung from the floor so the shaft can flex slightly.

universal.zh: 把傳動軸的轉動轉 90 度分給左右兩根半軸，而且過彎時允許兩邊轉速不同。裡面有終傳齒比（例如 3.x : 1），讓扭力再放大一次。
universal.en: Turns the propshaft drive through 90° to the two half-shafts and lets them turn at different speeds in corners. Its final-drive ratio multiplies torque once more.

specific.zh: 320i 終傳比待查證（手排與自排不同）。差速器掛在後副車架上，三顆螺絲，重約 30 kg（待查證），用頂車架接。
specific.en: 320i final-drive ratio unverified (manual and automatic differ). It bolts to the rear subframe with three bolts and weighs about 30 kg (unverified); catch it on a jack.

commonIssues.zh: 差速器油漏（輸出油封）；軸承嗚嗚聲隨車速變。
commonIssues.en: Oil leaks at the output seals; a bearing whine that follows road speed.

universal.zh: 差速器到輪子之間的軸，兩端各一個等速接頭（CV joint），懸吊上下動時仍能平順傳力。
universal.en: The shaft from the differential to the wheel, with a constant-velocity joint at each end so it keeps driving smoothly as the suspension moves.

specific.zh: 先鬆輪轂中心螺帽（很緊，要長柄扳手），再從差速器端拆螺絲或撬出卡簧。
specific.en: Loosen the big hub nut first (very tight, use a breaker bar), then unbolt or lever the inner end out of the diff.

commonIssues.zh: 防塵套破裂漏油脂，接頭磨損過彎喀喀響。
commonIssues.en: Split boots lose grease; a worn joint clicks in corners.

universal.zh: 差速器到輪子之間的軸，兩端各一個等速接頭（CV joint），懸吊上下動時仍能平順傳力。
universal.en: The shaft from the differential to the wheel, with a constant-velocity joint at each end so it keeps driving smoothly as the suspension moves.

specific.zh: 先鬆輪轂中心螺帽（很緊，要長柄扳手），再從差速器端拆螺絲或撬出卡簧。
specific.en: Loosen the big hub nut first (very tight, use a breaker bar), then unbolt or lever the inner end out of the diff.

commonIssues.zh: 防塵套破裂漏油脂，接頭磨損過彎喀喀響。
commonIssues.en: Split boots lose grease; a worn joint clicks in corners.
